name: Draggable Content
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Constants can be placed inside draggable cards, which users can then move to any location on the page in the frontend

Key features include:

  • Simple drag and drop functionality
  • Customizable content blocks that can contain text, images, videos or other media
  • Block settings to control appearance and behavior
  • Smooth animations and positioning
  • Compatible with all modern browsers

How to use Draggable Content

  • First, install the Draggable Content plugin from the WordPress dashboard.
  • Add the Draggable Content from the block category called “widgets” in the Gutenberg editor.
  • You can change block settings from the right-side settings sidebar.

  • Enjoy!

  • For installation help click on Installation Tab

sections.installation:
From Gutenberg Editor:

  1. Go to the WordPress Block/Gutenberg Editor
  2. Search For Draggable Content
  3. Click on the Draggable Content to add the block

Download & Upload:

  1. Download the Draggable Content plugin (.zip file)
  2. In your admin area, go to the Plugins menu and click on Add New
  3. Click on Upload Plugin and choose the draggable-content.zip file and click on Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin and Enjoy!

Manually:

  1. Download and upload the Draggable Content plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it will work with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

How many times can I reuse a block?

You can use unlimited times as you want.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here
